correctness.rationale: Commuting idempotents over every F_q diagonalize simultaneously because t(t-1) is separable even in characteristic 2. Their canonical joint eigenspaces V_epsilon form an ordered 2^m-part direct sum of F_q^n; the converse constructs all tuples uniquely. GL_n transitivity with stabilizer prod GL_{d_epsilon} proves the exact count including zero dimensional parts and n=0. For fixed n and q growing, the exponent of each orbit is n^2-sum d_epsilon^2, maximal for balanced ordered profiles. A two-part denominator has leading multiplicity 1 or 2; a four-part numerator has binomial(4,n mod4), giving exactly three stated probability cases, including coefficient 6 for n=2 mod4. Separately computed count from compositions for n<=3, q=2,3 (e.g. 40 at n=2,q=2, 76 at n=2,q=3). No assertion in simultaneous-conjugacy or growing-n limit.

The all-m enumeration is an immediate but nontrivial natural specialization requiring the simultaneous idempotent locus; treat the elementary derivation as prior mathematical technique, not newly discovered.
